name: empathy-map-builder
description: Builds empathy maps from real research data, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run empathy-map-builder", "make an empathy map", "map what users say and feel", "what's going on in our users' heads", or research exists and the team wants the says/thinks/does/feels view of a segment. Use it even for "help the team feel what the research found".
